title: Reading three letters at a time
hook: Predict the result, then reveal the sequence.

knows: DNA and RNA are sequences of chemical building blocks.
doesNotKnow: AUG encodes methionine, GCU encodes alanine and UAA is a stop codon in the standard genetic code. Stop ends translation rather than adding an amino acid.

misconception: The original sequence and the resulting sequence must have the same interpretation.
objective: AUG encodes methionine, GCU encodes alanine and UAA is a stop codon in the standard genetic code. Stop ends translation rather than adding an amino acid.

claims.text: Question, answer, diagram and explanation: Using the standard genetic code, an mRNA reads 5′–AUG GCU UAA–3′ starting at AUG. What does it specify before translation stops? AUG encodes methionine, GCU encodes alanine and UAA is a stop codon in the standard genetic code. Stop ends translation rather than adding an amino acid.
Recall: In the standard genetic code, what does UAA signal? UAA is a stop codon in the standard genetic code.
